elements.requirement: Section 1 defines the term “domestic abuse” for the purposes of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021.
elements.quote: defines “domestic abuse” for the purposes of this Act

elements.requirement: Behaviour of a person (“A”) towards another person (“B”) constitutes “domestic abuse” if person A and person B are each aged 16 or over, are personally connected to each other, and the behaviour is abusive.
elements.quote: Behaviour of a person (“A”) towards another person (“B”) is “domestic abuse” if— (a) A and B are each aged 16 or over and are personally connected to each other, and (b) the behaviour is abusive.

elements.requirement: Behaviour is “abusive” if it consists of physical or sexual abuse, violent or threatening behaviour, controlling or coercive behaviour, economic abuse, or psychological, emotional or other abuse.
elements.quote: Behaviour is “abusive” if it consists of any of the following— (a) physical or sexual abuse; (b) violent or threatening behaviour; (c) controlling or coercive behaviour; (d) economic abuse (see subsection (4)); (e) psychological, emotional or other abuse

elements.requirement: Behaviour may be abusive regardless of whether it consists of a single incident or a course of conduct.
elements.quote: it does not matter whether the behaviour consists of a single incident or a course of conduct

elements.requirement: “Economic abuse” means any behaviour that has a substantial adverse effect on person B's ability to acquire, use or maintain money or other property, or to obtain goods or services.
elements.quote: “Economic abuse” means any behaviour that has a substantial adverse effect on B's ability to— (a) acquire, use or maintain money or other property, or (b) obtain goods or services.

elements.requirement: For the purposes of the Domestic Abuse Act 2021, person A's behaviour may be behaviour “towards” person B even if it consists of conduct directed at another person, such as person B's child.
elements.quote: A's behaviour may be behaviour “towards” B despite the fact that it consists of conduct directed at another person (for example, B's child).

elements.requirement: References in the Domestic Abuse Act 2021 to being abusive towards another person must be read in accordance with section 1.
elements.quote: References in this Act to being abusive towards another person are to be read in accordance with this section.

elements.requirement: The definition and meaning of “personally connected” for the purposes of section 1 are set out in section 2.
elements.quote: For the meaning of “personally connected”, see section 2.

thresholds.what: minimum age of person A and person B for behaviour to qualify as domestic abuse
